name: DUMBBELL SWING
introduce:
Stand with your feet a little wider than shoulder-width apart. Slightly bend your knees. Hold a dumbbell vertically with both hands. 

Bend at your hips and lower your upper body until it’s at a 45-degree angle to the floor, and swing the dumbbell back between your knees.

Then drive your hips forward and swing the dumbbell to your chest height. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Squeeze your glutes when swinging the dumbbell forward.
